title: Aogiri Hub
features:
BAGAH HUB - GAKURAN

VERSION 0.1.0

Beta release. Features may change as Gakuran updates.

PLAYER

- Infinite Stamina - Prevent stamina depletion.

- No Dodge Cooldown - Remove the manual dodge cooldown.

- No Stun Animation - Stop local stun animations.

- Anti-Ragdoll - Recover from ragdoll states.

- Custom Dodge Cooldown - Set a preferred dodge cooldown value.

- Fly - Free flight with adjustable speed.

- No Clip - Walk through map collisions.

- Teleport to Player - Select, refresh, and teleport to another player.

COMBAT

- Perfect Auto Parry - Automatically parry detected attacks.

- Animation Sync - Adjust parry timing to animation speed.

- Parry Facing - Face an attacker before parrying.

- Grapple-Aware Combat - Respond to detected grapple attacks.

- Auto Punish - Counter after a successful perfect parry.

- Face Lock - Continuously face the selected nearby target.

- Block M1 Until Parry - Prevent M1 input from cancelling a parry block.

- Hold Through Combo - Keep blocking through fast attack chains.

- Facing Check - Only react to attackers facing your character.

- Parry Settings - Configure maximum distance, face target range, parry timing, block hold time, and ping adjustment.

- Fallback Safety Block - Briefly block when a valid parry cannot be triggered, with adjustable duration and range.

VISUALS

- ESP: Box, Health Bar, Stamina Bar, Tracer, Name and Info, Highlight / Chams, and adjustable ESP distance.

- Player HUD: On-screen health and stamina bars.

MUSIC GAME RHYTHM

- Rhythm Auto - Automatically plays Gakuran rhythm notes.

- Timing Mode - Choose Always Perfect or Custom Mix.

- Custom Mix Ratings - Configure PERFECT, GOOD, and OK chances.

- Press Lead - Apply a configurable early-input offset.

- Hold Extend - Extend long-note holds by a configurable amount.

AUTO PIANO

- Online Song Player - Search NanoMidi or load songs from My Songs.

- MIDI Conversion and Playback - Convert supported MIDI songs and play them on Gakuran pianos.

- 61-Key Piano Support - Supports white and black piano notes.

- Chord and Sustain Timing - Supports simultaneous chords, independent note lengths, and repeated notes.

- Mobile Piano Controls - Draggable floating controls for loading, browsing, playing, stopping, and viewing song info.

PERFORMANCE

- Anti Lag - Reversibly reduce materials, textures, effects, lights, post-effects, and water visuals.

- FPS Display - Toggle an FPS, ping, memory, and CPU monitor.

- Anti AFK - Simulate idle input to prevent auto-kick.

BASKETBALL

- Auto Green Shoot - Automatically release a basketball shot at the perfect meter timing while holding F.

SERVER

- View Server ID and Place ID.

- Copy a server link.

- Rejoin the current server.

- Server Hop.

- Hop to a small server.

CONFIGS AND UI

- Save, load, overwrite, and delete configurations.

- Per-place config autoload.

- UI settings and theme controls.

- Unload Bagah - Disables active features, removes the UI, and removes the FPS display.
